caption: Toddler Breakfast Bites ✈️🍳 These were SO simple to make and honestly aren’t just for toddlers — they’re an easy breakfast for the whole family! I enjoy them too, which makes them perfect for meal prep when you don’t want to make separate breakfasts for everyone. We have an upcoming flight, and I’m planning to pack these for my toddler so we have something homemade, filling, and easy to eat instead of having to grab airport food. ✈️ Ingredients: ✨ 1 cup ground chicken 🥕 Optional: finely chopped carrots + mushrooms 🥚 3 eggs — 2 scrambled + 1 raw for binding 🧀 ¼ cup cottage cheese 🧀 ¼ cup shredded cheese 🥄 2 tbsp all-purpose flour My ground chicken already had finely chopped carrots and mushrooms mixed in from another meal, so I used that! You can totally leave the veggies out or add whatever finely chopped veggies you have on hand. How to make: Cook the ground chicken until fully cooked (along with the veggies if using). Scramble 2 eggs separately. Let everything cool slightly, then combine with 1 raw egg, cottage cheese, shredded cheese, and flour. Form into little bites/patties and bake at 350°F convection for 25 minutes, until the edges are golden brown and the centers reach 165°F. Let them cool and enjoy! 🤍 Make a batch for the whole family or save them for an easy grab-and-go breakfast. Save this for your next busy morning or travel day! ✈️ #toddlerbreakfast #toddlerrecipes #toddlermeals #familybreakfast #easyrecipe
